name: 344. A Vertex batch line's custom_id that cannot be a request label is encoded, or refused when too long (vertex batch custom_id)
description: Contract C8 (TXE-6971): a Vertex Gemini batch line has no native custom_id, so the gateway carries it in request labels, whose values hold at most 63 lowercase letters, digits, underscores and dashes. A custom_id that is a label value travels as it is in bifrost_custom_id; any other (an uppercase letter, a dot, more than 63 characters) is base32-encoded across bifrost_custom_id_b32_<n> labels and decoded on results, so it comes back unchanged and never reaches Vertex as a label its rules forbid. A custom_id that has to be encoded and is longer than 256 bytes is refused with a 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming requests[i].custom_id before anything is uploaded. Rows 1 and 2 run on the Vertex endpoint fixture (vertex-endpoint-fixture.mjs, vertexEndpointFixture=1), which keeps the JSONL the gateway uploads to Cloud Storage, finishes the batch job at once and writes its predictions file from the uploaded lines: row 1 reads the labels the gateway sent, row 2 reads each custom_id back from results. They are skipped without the fixture, since a live pin would need a batch run to completion. Row 3 is answered by the gateway alone, with no vendor call.

item.name: 344.1 vertex vertex batch custom_id: every custom_id is uploaded as labels Vertex accepts, encoded when it is not a label value

exec: pm.test('the batch is created on the fixture', function () { pm.expect(j.id, pm.response.text().slice(0, 400)).to.match(/batchPredictionJobs\/\d+$/); });
pm.test('three lines were uploaded', function () { pm.expect(labels.length, input.body.slice(0, 400)).to.equal(3); });
pm.test('every label key and value the gateway sent is one Vertex accepts', function () {

pm.test('a custom_id that is a label value travels as it is', function () { pm.expect(labels[0], JSON.stringify(labels[0])).to.include({ bifrost_custom_id: 'order-42' }); pm.expect(labels[0]).to.not.have.property('bifrost_custom_id_b32_0'); });

pm.test('a custom_id with characters a label forbids is encoded in one label', function () { pm.expect(labels[1], JSON.stringify(labels[1])).to.have.property('bifrost_custom_id_b32_0'); pm.expect(labels[1]).to.not.have.property('bifrost_custom_id'); pm.expect(labels[1]).to.not.have.property('bifrost_custom_id_b32_1'); });

pm.test('a longer custom_id is encoded across several labels', function () { pm.expect(labels[2], JSON.stringify(labels[2])).to.have.property('bifrost_custom_id_b32_0'); pm.expect(labels[2]).to.have.property('bifrost_custom_id_b32_1'); pm.expect(labels[2]).to.not.have.property('bifrost_custom_id'); });

item.name: 344.2 vertex vertex batch custom_id: results return each custom_id exactly as the caller sent it

exec: pm.test('the three results carry the caller\'s custom_ids, unchanged and in order', function () { pm.expect(ids, pm.response.text().slice(0, 600)).to.eql(["order-42","Order.42:Retry","Tenant/7:Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.Line.End"]); });

pm.test('each result is a chat completion', function () { (j.results || []).forEach(function (r) { pm.expect(((r.response || {}).body || {}).object, JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 300)).to.equal('chat.completion'); }); });
